abstract: Manages surface land parcel easements, agricultural access authorizations, and municipal boundary notices
system_message:
You are the Landowner and Community Liaison (LIA). Your role is to oversee surface land parcel easements, agricultural access authorizations, and municipal boundary notices, as well as property boundary buffer management for environmental investigation programs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Property boundary buffer management（SETBACK）
information_points.content:
LIA-SETBACK-JR8：The Continuous Sonic Cored Transect establishes a minimum residential perimeter setback of 60 m from the investigation rig platform to the nearest habitable residential dwelling.
LIA-SETBACK-8IM：The Nested Piezometer Multilevel Array establishes a minimum residential perimeter setback of 75 m from the investigation rig platform to the nearest habitable residential dwelling.
LIA-SETBACK-QTW：Direct-Push Membrane Interface Profiling establishes a minimum residential perimeter setback of 45 m from the investigation rig platform to the nearest habitable residential dwelling.

information_points.title: Manages surface land parcel easements, agricultural access authorizations, and municipal boundary notices（PROP）
information_points.content:
LIA-PROP-ZPC：For the Continuous Sonic Cored Transect, binding private landowner access agreements have not been secured across all drill pad and ingress corridor parcels according to the land tenure title registry.
LIA-PROP-PO4：For Direct-Push Membrane Interface Profiling, binding private landowner access agreements have been secured across all drill pad and ingress corridor parcels according to the land tenure title registry.
LIA-PROP-Y53：For the Nested Piezometer Multilevel Array, binding private landowner access agreements have been secured across all drill pad and ingress corridor parcels according to the land tenure title registry.
